description: RESEAU DE TRANSPORTS COLLECTIFS - A COMPTER DU 1ER JUILLET 2026 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by COMMUNAUTE D'AGGLOMERATION DES 2 BAIES EN MONTREUILLOIS. Ces données concernent le réseau de transports collectifs de la CA2BM et sont valables du 1er juillet 2026 au 30 juin 2027. elles concernent les lignes régulières, les navettes, et les doublages scolaires. ne sont pas intégrés les circuits spéciaux scolaires. Coverage: COMMUNAUTE D'AGGLOMERATION DES 2 BAIES EN MONTREUILLOIS. The publisher named on the listing is COMMUNAUTE D'AGGLOMERATION DES 2 BAIES EN MONTREUILLOIS. Its keywords include deplacements-transports, transports-deplacements, transports, transports-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
